candidate_selection: same predeclared Phase 3 category limits and deterministic ordering as the single-window catalog; duplicates merged
window_rule: remove the directed edge in every final-schedule window where its normalized weight is positive; renormalize each affected row

control_matching.pool: all other real directed non-self relations retained in at least one final-schedule window
control_matching.distance: absolute retained-window-count difference, then absolute mean-normalized-weight difference, then source-target order
